f603d2b02ad136c48f05ebca62271200.overview: In the early years of the 20th century, Mohandas K. Gandhi, a British-trained lawyer, forsakes all worldly possessions to take up the cause of Indian independence. Faced with armed resistance from the British government, Gandhi adopts a policy of 'passive resistance', endeavouring to win freedom for his people without resorting to bloodshed.
f603d2b02ad136c48f05ebca62271200.tagline: His triumph changed the world forever.

f6584ce4f888b0943653326b0168094f.overview: Hired to helm an Americanized take on a British play, director Lloyd Fellowes does his best to control an eccentric group of stage actors. With a star actress quickly passing her prime, a male lead with no confidence, and a bit actor that's rarely sober, chaos ensues in the lead up to a Broadway premiere.
f6584ce4f888b0943653326b0168094f.tagline: The comedy where everyone gets caught in the act.

f666f10ae608909e04be4f77e0ac72d5.overview: A prisoner leads his counterparts in a protest for better living conditions which turns violent and ugly.
f666f10ae608909e04be4f77e0ac72d5.tagline: FILMED ON THE SPOT BEHIND PRISON WALLS!

f676179608ee5e2286d140f96cdbb475.overview: On a cold Monday morning, a group of counselors clock in at an old-fashioned social services office. Their task is to interview the recently deceased, record their personal details, then, over the course of the week, assist them in choosing a single memory to keep for eternity.
f676179608ee5e2286d140f96cdbb475.tagline: What is the one memory you would take with you?

f67e697fb4a6eb75490d1f04499fc16f.overview: In London, barrister Anthony Keane takes the case of Maddalena Paradine, a beautiful woman accused of poisoning her blind husband. Though happily married, Keane becomes infatuated with his enigmatic client and convinced of her innocence. His obsession clouds his judgment as he builds a defense implicating her servant, André Latour—an act that leads to devastating consequences both in court and at home.
f67e697fb4a6eb75490d1f04499fc16f.tagline: The dramatic case of a beautiful woman whose trial for murder held the nation spellbound.

f6b56dee63cc57a3a851932a4079beaa.overview: During the Vietnam War, a soldier finds himself the outsider of his own squad when they unnecessarily kidnap a female villager.
f6b56dee63cc57a3a851932a4079beaa.tagline: Even in war… murder is murder.

f6eebfea51520af8d47483e949ab8cf2.overview: During World War II, a young man is called up and, with an increasing sense of foreboding, undertakes his army training ready for D-Day, June 6th, 1944.

f6f186a27b72b82cd57f55b1182dba93.overview: A disk jockey goes to Vietnam to work for the Armed Forces Radio Service. While he becomes popular among the troops, his superiors disapprove of his humor.
f6f186a27b72b82cd57f55b1182dba93.tagline: The wrong man. In the wrong place. At the right time.
